integrity: The infinite-horizon statements are analytic. Exact rational replay checks algebraic identities but is not used as a substitute for the Markov-chain proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the scalar strongly convex quadratic, iid Rademacher candidate specialization, fixed positive probing and update radii, and first-minimizer tie rule. The symmetric two-point modification, adaptive step sizes, and acceptance rules are outside scope.
title: Exact Markov error floor for the always-move direct structured search
